weaknesses: The abstract overstates the novelty of CipherChat and SelfCipher without adequately comparing them to existing methods.
The paper lacks a thorough discussion of the ethical implications of enabling unsafe interactions with LLMs.
The experimental setup does not include a comprehensive range of baseline models for comparison, limiting the generalizability of the findings.
The claims regarding the 'secret cipher' within LLMs are not sufficiently substantiated with empirical evidence.
strengths: The paper presents a novel framework, CipherChat, that explores the vulnerability of LLMs to cipher-based prompting.
The multi-lingual and cross-cipher safety stress tests provide valuable insights into the limitations of current safety alignment techniques.
The introduction of SelfCipher offers an interesting approach to leveraging LLMs' internal mechanisms for unsafe outputs.
